claims: Portugal defeated the United States 2-0 in a men's international friendly match held on March 31, 2026, at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta, Georgia.
The match was a preparation for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
Cristiano Ronaldo did not participate in the match due to a muscle injury.
In October 2025, Portugal defeated the United States men's national team.
In October 2025, the USWNT defeated Portugal 3-1 in a friendly match.
The USWNT and Portugal drew 0-0 in the FIFA World Cup 2023.
The match was part of the USMNT's "Road to 2026" preparation
